components.css: .ds-transport{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1.7fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:10px 16px;background:#14161a;color:#f4f5f7;font:400 12.5px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.ds-transport__track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0}.ds-transport__track img{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:6px;object-fit:cover}.ds-transport__title{margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-transport__meta{margin:1px 0 0;color:#a7aeb9;font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-transport__controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.ds-transport__controls button{height:40px;min-width:38px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:#c3c9d2;cursor:pointer;font:700 9px/1 system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-transport__controls .ds-transport__play{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:#e50526;color:#fff;font-size:0}.ds-transport__seek{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}.ds-transport__seek span{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#a7aeb9;font-size:11.5px}.ds-transport__seek span:first-child{color:#fff}.ds-transport__bar{height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(to right,#e50526 0 12%,#3a3f48 12% 100%)}.ds-transport__bar i{display:block;width:14px;height:14px;margin:-5px 0 0 11%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(229,5,38,.35)}.ds-transport__close{width:38px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:#c3c9d2;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}.ds-transport__close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff}.ds-transport :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: This is a schedule you can play, not a media library in a card grid. The day is the section, the time slot is the spine, and a programme is a row you scan the way you scan a printed radio guide. The surface belongs to the station's own newspaper theme: it inherits the type, the page width and the light ground, and adds only structure, hairlines and one dark piece of hardware at the bottom.
keyCharacteristics: Time-first hierarchy: the hour is the largest repeated anchor after the title.
One transport for the whole surface; no inline duplicate players.
Station red is reserved for playback, position, primary actions and focus.
Flat schedule: hairline rules and tonal panels, no card shadows per row.
Inherited typography; no webfont, no icon font, no external asset service.
Every pixel is identical for every visitor, so the page can stay cached.

rules.name: The Playback-Only Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks playback, current position, the primary action and focus. It is not decoration: no red borders, no red heading rules, no red eyebrows, no second red button competing with play.

rules.name: The Dark Hardware Rule
rules.body: Only the transport is dark. The page stays light so the plugin reads as part of the station's site, not as a dark media app pasted into it.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time, duration and position uses tabular numerals. The time rail must stay on the same optical column as the digits change from 9:00 to 10:00.

dos: Do keep the time rail tabular and on one optical column.
Do keep the page output identical for every visitor: no nonces, no per-user values, no cookies in the shortcode markup.
Do keep one transport; playback must survive filtering, paging and scrolling.
Do reserve red for playback, position, primary action and focus.
Do keep rows flat and separate days with a hairline and 22px of air.
Do show the time first in the mobile meta line, because the rail is gone.
donts: Don't turn rows into cards with shadows, or put a cover thumbnail in every hourly row.
Don't duplicate the player inside the expanded row.
Don't put a nonce or a user-specific value in cached HTML; that was the original bug.
Don't use display fonts, all-caps sentences or letter-spaced body copy.
Don't use red for passive labels, counts, day headings or borders.
Don't hide the close button behind a site chat widget.
